evidence.title: Portal login
evidence.body:
**Portal login**
1. Open https://portal.nelf.gov.ng/auth/login
2. Sign in with the email/phone already registered for NELFUND.
3. If you forgot the password, use **Forgot password** on that same login page.
4. Official site: https://nelf.gov.ng/
Do not send passwords or OTP to anyone in chat or WhatsApp.

evidence.title: Account already exists
evidence.body:
**Account already exists / email already used**
That message means the email (or phone) already has a NELFUND account — often from an earlier cycle.
**Sign in** at https://portal.nelf.gov.ng/auth/login — do **not** create a second account.
Use Forgot password on the same email if needed.
Support: https://nelfund.esupport.ng/create
Portal: https://portal.nelf.gov.ng/

evidence.title: How to apply
evidence.body:
**How to apply**
1. Open https://portal.nelf.gov.ng/ — create account or sign in.
2. Complete Profile (JAMB, NIN, BVN, bank) as the form requires.
3. Use the portal menu: ☰ → Loans → Request Loan (wording can vary slightly by release).
4. Choose institutional charges and/or upkeep if offered on your session.
5. Upload required documents (including admission letter when asked), accept Terms & GSI when shown, then Submit.
Confirm live steps only on the portal.

**Upkeep** (if offered on your session) is optional living support paid to your bank account when selected and approved; institutional charges go to the school. Confirm amounts only on the portal.
Portal: https://portal.nelf.gov.ng/

evidence.title: Pending / application status
evidence.body:
**Pending application / what next**
Pending means a request was submitted and is still processing — it is not the same as declined.
**What to do next:**
1. Login https://portal.nelf.gov.ng/auth/login
2. Open ☰ → Loans and check your exact status tabs (Pending vs Approved vs Declined).
3. If the portal shows missing information, ask your school to finish uploading your record.
4. Confirm live notices on https://portal.nelf.gov.ng/
This guide cannot see your personal account or jump the queue.
Tickets: https://nelfund.esupport.ng/create
Portal: https://portal.nelf.gov.ng/

evidence.title: Disbursement / approval timing
evidence.body:
**Approval / disbursement timing**
This guide cannot give a personal approval clock or a guaranteed payout date.
Timing depends on school uploads, verification, and cycle rules shown on the portal.
1. Login https://portal.nelf.gov.ng/auth/login → ☰ → Loans for live status.
2. Confirm notices on https://portal.nelf.gov.ng/ and https://nelf.gov.ng/
3. Do not pay agents who promise faster disbursement.
4. Official tickets: https://nelfund.esupport.ng/create

evidence.title: Missing information
evidence.body:
**Missing information**
That portal state usually means the school has not finished uploading your student record or fee data.
You cannot invent the fields from this chat.
1. Visit campus NELFUND / ICT / Registry desk with admission + JAMB + matric if issued.
2. Ask them to complete the upload required by NELFUND.
3. Re-check the portal after they confirm.
4. Ticket with screenshot: https://nelfund.esupport.ng/create
Portal: https://portal.nelf.gov.ng/

If you see **No Result found** when selecting institution, try shorter school names and confirm the school is on the portal list; campus desk can help if your school is missing.
Portal: https://portal.nelf.gov.ng/

evidence.title: Is application open
evidence.body:
**Application window / open status**
Cycle label in guide pack: 2026/2027.
Status rule: Confirm live on the official portal only.
Dates sometimes appear in secondary reports. They are NOT a substitute for what the portal shows today.
Always confirm on https://portal.nelf.gov.ng/ whether Request Loan is available on your account.
National window text is not a substitute for what the portal shows for your school session.
Sources: https://portal.nelf.gov.ng/, https://portal.nelf.gov.ng/auth/login, https://nelf.gov.ng/
